f3_program: observe(at("finjan.contractual_obligations.finjan_mobile_future_commitment", "less_than_1_year"), 650, "thousand_dollar", cell("Finjan Mobile future commitment", "Less Than 1 Year"))
collection("donna.cake.pieces", "cake_piece", "donna.cake", source("Twice as many pieces as her snack were left"))
consume("party_guests_eat", "party.guests", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("the guests ate half the cake"))

transfer("share_with_brothers", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), at("donna.brothers.cake_pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("The day after the party, she shared half the leftovers with her brothers"))
consume("midnight_snack", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, source("The following day, she ate one piece as a midnight snack"))
multiple(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), event_field("midnight_snack", "quantity"), 2, source("Twice as many pieces as her snack were left"))
collection("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts", "weekly_text_message_count", "keiko", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week. This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week"))
member("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts", "keiko.weekly_text_message_counts.last_week", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))
member("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts", "keiko.weekly_text_message_counts.this_week", source("This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week"))
observe(at("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts.last_week", "current"), 111, "count", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))

offset(at("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts.this_week", "current"), scale(at("keiko.weekly_text_message_counts.last_week", "current"), 2), -50, "count", source("This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week"))
